This bus terminal connects Pattaya to Suvarnabhumi Airport. It's also called Jomtien Bus Terminal. From Pattaya city, take a songthaew departing from the intersection of South Pattaya Road and Second Road for 10B. Note that buses to Ekkamai in Bangkok depart from North Pattaya Bus Terminal. Tickets to Suvarnabhumi Airport cost 143B, and reservations can be made two days in advance. Reservations are also available online (with a 25B handling fee). Any changes after purchase (such as changing the time) cost 50B. Buses depart approximately every hour from 7:00 AM, with the last bus at 9:00 PM. Carry-on luggage is free, but checked baggage costs 20B for up to 20kg, 50B for up to 30kg, and 100B for up to 50kg. The air conditioning on the bus is strong, so be sure to take precautions against the cold (though there is a toilet at the end of the bus). If the roads are not congested, you can arrive within two hours. Seats are unreserved. Please note that eating is prohibited on board the train.
Highly recommended.  No stops or layovers all the way to airport.

This bus is a welcome relief for backpackers, with blazing air conditioning and comfortable seats. The ride takes about two hours.
